name: genomics-mcp
description: Genomic data and reference evidence through a local Docker container
long_description: Runs the pinned ghcr.io/rewire-bio/genomics-mcp linux/amd64 image with Docker. Only the chosen data directory (read-only) and a separate workspace are mounted. No cloud credentials are passed. Public archive and reference sources are queried over the network; see the README for sources and limits. Research use only.

docker_path.title: Docker executable
docker_path.description: Absolute path to the Docker CLI, e.g. /usr/local/bin/docker. The Docker daemon must be running and able to run linux/amd64 images.

data_root.title: Read-only data directory
data_root.description: Mounted read-only at /data. Not your home directory.

work_dir.title: Workspace directory
work_dir.description: A separate, dedicated writable directory for downloads, indexes and cache (bounded to 10 GiB).
